photos.c: Above: Kit Carrier Rhian Letang, one of the regulars in the Women's Southern League under 15 section spares a few minutes for some guy who's just run in the World Cup Final 400 metres - fellow Belgravian Du'aine Ladejo!
Photo (over page) by Gray Mortimore/Allsport. Du'aine Ladejo of Belgrave Harriers brings Britain home to a gold medal in the 1994 European Games 4 x 400 metres relay in Helsinki

The name Du'aine Ladejo became infinitely better known to the public after his golden exploits in Helsinki. Three times the 23 year-old reduced our 400m Club Record in 1994 but it doesn't look as if it's going to stop there for he was quoted after the European Championships final as saying, "You haven't seen anything yet".

Front Page Photo: Du'aine Ladejo set his best Decathlon score while competing at the Commonwealth Games in Kuala Lumpur — in spite of an awful long jump that had him on the verge of scoring no points at all in that discipline. Gaining experience in the event all the time, he will surely top 8,000 points in ‘99.

Below: Du'aine Ladejo, Matt Douglas, Geoff Dearman and Sean Baldock (still breathing hard after his last leg stint) enjoy the attention after providing the most dominating display of the evening. It was Du'aine's last race before signing for Birchfield Harriers.
